scope: Public first-party research for Durham/east and approved outer GTA municipalities; private-practice firms only.

comparison_baseline: Batch 001-010 canonical domains plus current 103-record manifest were checked before lane drafting. Parallel Batch 011 Toronto/west reconciliation remains required; unresolved possible collisions are held.
